session_selection.time_basis: UTC timestamps from the manually selected bundled Codex root rollout
session_selection.rationale: Selected workspace-local Codex root 01a03d7e-99c6-7d13-ae48-99ca3c243884 because it owns the benchmark implementation and 25 named subagents spanning mesh, solver, report, results, and audits. Extraction is confined to this workspace .sessions bundle; Docker cwd /workspace was rebased only to the bundled rollout. Terminal text uses the last non-null persisted task_complete message, with source/message hashes in metadata.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source clean build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3GiB, 256 pids) after explicit JSON include path; documented root settings alone did not locate header in image.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:315–334 reads restart state but discards restored time/step and prior states before run_transient, which starts time0 and reconstructs history. Steady state restart is distinct; no transient restart test.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Clear separation of physics, mesh, MPI, numerics, and I/O.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal copied-core evidence; trust policy excludes web search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Generic case-file paths; no mesh-name-only dispatch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:52–73 calls METIS; halo_exchange.cpp:36–55 exchanges neighbor data and communicator.cpp:82,112–159 reduces scalars/vectors; main.cpp:258–278 releases global mesh before solve.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Validation, positivity handling, and explicit error paths are present.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Independent clean build ran the unit suite successfully with supplied benchmark meshes mounted read-only; initial missing mount caused four mesh-check errors, resolved by mounting at its expected path. No CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated tip excludes raw artifacts and retains source/report figures.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report/source agree on conservative nondimensional Euler/NS formulation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_reader.cpp:123,293–337 handles multiple zones and TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 sections; mixed triangles and quads in separate sections are supported. CGNS MIXED element sections fall through to an error.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: residual.cpp:163–251 assembles each face flux with opposite signs on owned adjacent cells, including inviscid and viscous terms.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: HLLC production flux plus Roe/Rusanov alternatives are implemented.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip, and no-slip wall paths inspected.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: gradients.cpp:9–29,103 and residual.cpp:83–108 implement least-squares gradients and limited face states; report.tex:395–410,454–517 documents first-order cells and limiter freezing.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat/Barth and positivity exist; production freeze/fallback is documented.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: viscous_flux.cpp:41–57 removes normal traction; forces.cpp:69–74,100–113 integrates tangential shear; boundary-condition values are written to surface rows at forces.cpp:173–179.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL local pseudo-time and LU-SGS are implemented.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Selected raw Re200 force history reaches t=300; metadata reports 169/30000 target misses (99.44% success). Final source implements BDF2 and explicit residual-ratio checks, but its exact identity with the executed binary is unproven because the configured revision stamp conflicts with the selected launch option.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:52–73 invokes METIS; halo_exchange.cpp:36–55 and communicator.cpp:82,112–159 provide neighbor exchanges/reductions. Report rank tables compare np2/4/8; timing is unsuitable to establish scaling.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight readable raw packages have required contract artifacts.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit examiner invocation passes all eight packages and report.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Steady last-50 windows span iterations 1544–1593 (M015 inviscid) and 3201–3250 (M080 inviscid); Cd oscillates 0.001646–0.001893 in the former and Cl rises 0.000916–0.002436 in the latter despite Cd-only stopping. Near-zero lift and absent later history limit inference; DQ7 is not established by these variations alone.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 measured St0.1801/Cd1.2424/Cl amplitude0.4902 is low against stated reference; selected inviscid force tails show significant sensitivity and M2 laminar drag differs from same-Mach inviscid. Numerical limits do not prove fabricated outputs.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 42-page report contains extensive figures; sole Re200 force plot compresses late Cd beneath startup, failing explicit late-lift/drag floor.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Detailed report is candid; clean-tip rank-study regeneration inconsistency remains.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Committed generated rank table is readable but raw rank-study inputs are absent at tip. Re200 metadata stamps configure-time revision339d65f, whose parser does not support --linear-check-interval used in the matching selected launch; the actual binary source is not established.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable 6f43c42 source builds with explicit NLOHMANN_JSON_INCLUDE_DIR; documented external-root arguments alone did not find the installed header. main.cpp:315–334 reads restart time/previous states into temporary variables but never passes them to driver; transient_driver.cpp:60–63,86–96 resets time/history. Real state restart exists; uninterrupted BDF continuation does not.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Final cgns_reader.cpp:123,293–337 handles multiple zones and TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 sections; a CGNS MIXED section is unsupported. Mixed elements in separate sections satisfy the stated mixed-cell capability. Geometry/adjacency and partition paths inspected.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Final residual.cpp:163–251 assembles signed face fluxes; boundary_conditions.cpp:14–41 constructs slip and zero-velocity viscous wall states. Inviscid/viscous paths are separately implemented.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: gradients.cpp:9–29,103 and limiter.cpp:27,114 implement weighted least squares, limiting and positivity. Report.tex:395–410,454–517 discloses first-order cells and steady/transient limiter freezes; source/source-to-run binding is limited as separately documented.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: viscous_flux.cpp:41–57 removes the normal part of traction; forces.cpp:69–74,100–113 integrates tangential shear. Surface rows use boundary velocity at forces.cpp:173–179, not adjacent cell centers.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Final transient_driver.cpp:189–214 constructs spatial plus BDF physical-time residual and checks its ratio; selected raw force history reaches t=300 and metadata reports 169/30000 target misses. The exact historical transient binary source is not established, so implementation attribution remains provisional.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: partition.cpp:52–73 calls METIS, halo_exchange.cpp:36–55 uses neighbor sends/receives and communicator.cpp:82,112–159 reductions. main.cpp:258–278 releases root global mesh before iteration. Rank table supports comparisons; unstable wall times do not establish scaling.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Selected M015 inviscid final50 Cd range0.0016464–0.0018931 despite nearly equal endpoints; M080 inviscid Cl rises0.000916–0.002436 over final50. Both limit steady force confidence. M2 laminar settles over last50 after a 9.7% 400-row Cd drop; Re200 accuracy/visualization separately qualified.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Extensive report/figures, but the only Re200 force plot compresses late drag and does not meet explicit late lift/drag floor; rank-study raw data absent from curated tip also limits clean regeneration.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics, boundary, mesh, numerics and solve paths are distinct; mesh geometry and state remain 2-D, limiting 3-D generality.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Original 4.5→3: selected np8 final Cd0.0017098, Cl0.000034445 at generated/force_table.tex:7; old note used rank2 table values Cd0.001832, Cl0.000155. Immutable force plot visibly shows decaying oscillations; selected last50 Cd0.0016464–0.0018931 (14.4% of final Cd) and Cl−0.0002957→+0.0000344; last100 Cd0.0012579–0.0020459. Status labels converged because the two Cd endpoints 50 steps apart nearly coincide (0.081% difference), yet their intervening range is much larger. Drag is small in absolute terms and oscillations decay, so DQ7 remains under review rather than inferred solely from a near-zero relative ratio. Report supplies numeric summary, residual/force plot and Mach field. Metadata revision2dff352; no CFD rerun.

limitations: No evaluator clean build or MPI rerun was performed.
Rank-study raw inputs are excluded at the curated result tip although generated rank tables remain committed.
Re200 has documented 7-10% Strouhal, about 7% drag, and 25-30% lift-amplitude deficits.
Production limiter freezes and terminal first-order fallback cells limit formal second-order evidence.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
